title: Cancel ChatGPT Plus India: Web, Android & iPhone (2026)
metaDescription: Cancel ChatGPT Plus from the web, Google Play or the App Store, stop the next renewal, and check any UPI mandate. Plain steps for users in India.
h1: How do I cancel ChatGPT Plus from India and stop future charges?
summary: To cancel ChatGPT Plus in India, sign in to ChatGPT on the web, open Settings, select Billing and choose Cancel under Cancel plan. If you subscribed through Google Play or the Apple App Store, you must cancel in that store, because cancelling on the web does not end a store subscription. Cancel at least 24 hours before your next billing date, and paid features continue until the end of the current billing period.
stepsHeading: How to cancel ChatGPT Plus step by step

steps.name: Find out where you subscribed
steps.text: Check your payment receipt first. A plan bought on chatgpt.com does not appear in your Apple or Google subscriptions, and a store plan does not appear in the web billing settings. OpenAI says to cancel through the platform that billed you, signed in with the account used for the purchase.

steps.name: Cancel a web-billed plan
steps.text: Sign in to ChatGPT, open your account menu, choose Settings, select Billing, then under Cancel plan select Cancel. OpenAI's other help pages show slightly different labels, such as Subscription and then Manage, so look for the cancel option under Billing or Subscription settings if the names differ.

steps.name: Cancel an Android or Google Play plan
steps.text: Open the Play Store app, go to Subscriptions, select ChatGPT, choose Cancel subscription and follow the prompts. You can also open your Google Play subscriptions on the web, sign in with the same Google account, click Manage next to ChatGPT and choose Cancel subscription.

steps.name: Cancel an iPhone App Store plan
steps.text: Open Settings, tap your name, tap Subscriptions, choose ChatGPT, then select Cancel Subscription and confirm. If there is no cancel button and an expiry date is shown, the subscription has already been cancelled.

steps.name: Do not rely on uninstalling or deleting
steps.text: Uninstalling the ChatGPT app does not cancel a subscription. Deleting your ChatGPT account cancels only plans billed directly by ChatGPT, so cancel any App Store plan before you delete the account.

steps.name: Check your payment method
steps.text: Removing a saved card or UPI method does not stop a subscription. After cancelling, check the AutoPay or Mandates section of your UPI app, or your card statement, for any ChatGPT charge still scheduled.

sections.heading: Why the store you paid through matters
paragraphs: ChatGPT Plus can be bought on the web, through Google Play on Android, or through the Apple App Store on iPhone. Each store keeps its own renewal schedule, so the web Billing page cannot stop a plan that Apple or Google is charging. If you have used more than one route, check each one.

If you cannot find the Cancel option, the usual cause is that you are signed in to a different ChatGPT account, or that you have two subscriptions on different platforms. Sign in with the account that received the receipt and check the store that matches it.

sections.heading: What happens after you cancel
paragraphs: A normal cancellation stops future renewals but keeps paid features on until the end of the current billing period. OpenAI advises cancelling at least 24 hours before your next billing date so that the next period is not charged. Cancelling does not refund charges you have already paid.

Refunds are a separate request from cancellation. For a web purchase, OpenAI's refund article says a discretionary refund may be available for an unused individual subscription if you contact OpenAI within seven days of the charge. This is not guaranteed. Apple purchases must be refunded by Apple. For Google Play purchases, OpenAI's help article says to request the refund through OpenAI Support while signed in to the ChatGPT account used for the charge. Google's own policy also gives a 48-hour window for some refund requests, so act early.

sections.heading: UPI and card payments in India
paragraphs: OpenAI's multi-currency billing article says Indian rupees are supported and that UPI is available for Go and Plus plans on web purchases, but not for Pro or Business. In the ChatGPT Go promotion for India, UPI users may see a temporary ₹1 charge each billing cycle to verify the payment method. OpenAI says it is refunded.

The OpenAI pages I could read did not describe a UPI AutoPay mandate that ChatGPT creates on your behalf, so do not assume one exists. If a recurring UPI mandate in your UPI app still shows a ChatGPT or OpenAI payee after you cancel, revoke it there. For a card, check the recurring payments with your bank.

sections.heading: Tracking the renewal date in Essara
paragraphs: Add ChatGPT Plus to Essara with its renewal date, its cost and whether it is billed through the web, Google Play or the App Store. Essara sends a reminder before each renewal and shows what renews in the next 30 days, so you can cancel in time. You add the entry yourself. Essara does not connect to your bank, UPI app or SMS.

faqs.q: Will cancelling ChatGPT Plus refund my last payment?
faqs.a: Not automatically. OpenAI says cancelling stops future renewals but does not refund past charges. A web refund may be possible if you contact OpenAI within seven days of an unused charge, and Apple purchases are refunded by Apple.

faqs.q: Do I keep ChatGPT Plus after I cancel?
faqs.a: Yes, until the end of the current billing period. Paid features remain available until then, and the subscription does not renew after that date.

faqs.q: Why is there a ₹1 charge on my UPI account?
faqs.a: On the ChatGPT Go promotion for India, OpenAI says UPI users may see a temporary ₹1 charge in each billing cycle. It is used to verify the payment method and is refunded.

faqs.q: Does deleting my ChatGPT account cancel the subscription?
faqs.a: It cancels plans billed directly by ChatGPT. It does not cancel an Apple App Store subscription, so cancel that in your iPhone settings first.
